items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: they had made an arrangement for George to play three weeks with Kaye in Germany, you see. And after we got there, everybody wanted to book the band

ctx.x: Did they have a sign up to know that they were welcoming you or something?

Well, yeah, they was all hollering, George Lewis, you know, and they had signs and they played. So when we got in, when they got to playing, when the ship landed, they came on the ship and it happened to be Chris Barbara and his band. And so anyway, well, that was fine. And we talked with them and we came on off the ship. It'd take a little time, you know, because we came off the ship. So that night we went where these fellows were playing at. And they played real good. So we left there. We left that Sunday and…
